home.description: your home: a shelter under the city
home.about: a concrete shelter with a barred door

start.description: the ruins above the shelter: gutted offices and flats, scrap, wire and the odd tin

gather: Scavenge the ruins for 15-60 minutes: scrap, wire, glass, old cells, cloth, now and then a tin or a tool. What you find is down to luck and how picked-over it is. You'll see what you found when the time is up; resting stops early.
browse: look over the ruins to see what's worth digging for

start.about: the ruins of the city above

start.description: the river flats past the old bridge: driftwood, reeds, roots and crayfish

gather: Forage the river flats for 15-60 minutes: driftwood, reeds, clay, roots and crayfish. What you find is down to luck and the river. You'll see what you found when the time is up; resting stops early.
